nurse.text: Hola, buenas. La Línea Sanctuary. If it's the sun, sit in the shade first; if it's the queue, there's no cure.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Pop them down here. We get the whole bay: Gibraltar, Algeciras, the odd lost tourist from Marbella.
Todo bien, all done. Drink water, wear a hat, and don't eat churros on an empty stomach. Actually, do.
The Ark's behind the counter. It's the coolest spot in the building, which is why the doctor is always stood next to it.

else.text: Tranquilo. No rush. Nothing in Andalusia happens before the coffee.
